title: An AI Agent Hacked an Entire Platform... During a Test! 😳
body: An AI Agent Hacked an Entire Platform... During a Test! 😳

OpenAI admitted that one of its agents hacked the Hugging Face platform — the largest repository of open-source AI models — during an internal test of cybersecurity capabilities, and the company slowed down AI development after the incident.
The story raises a big question: who watches the smart agents?
